title: Riot X Nic Salts Blueberry Strawberry Watermelon 10ml E-Liquid
description: Riot X Nic Salts Blueberry Strawberry Watermelon is a vibrant and exceptionally well-balanced fruit medley that celebrates classic summer profiles. The inhale features the rich, authentic sweetness of ripe Blueberry and classic Strawberry, delivering a deeply satisfying berry foundation. This is then smoothly layered with the refreshing and distinctively juicy taste of Watermelon on the exhale, creating a clean and highly consistent taste experience. This e-liquid features Riot's Hybrid Nicotine formula, which blends Nic Salt and freebase for quick satisfaction, a smooth throat feel, and modest vapour production. With its 50VG/50PG profile, this vape juice is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping and performs well with pod kits, refillable starter kits, and compact vape pens. Made in the UK, the Riot X Nic Salts range focuses on full-impact fruit blends designed for everyday use in low-powered refillable devices.
